returns.currencyAddress: currency address for purchases of project on this minter. Null address reserved for ether.
returns.currencySymbol: currency symbol for purchases of project on this minter. "ETH" reserved for ether.
returns.isConfigured: true only if token price has been configured on this minter
returns.tokenPriceInWei: current price of token on this minter - invalid if price has not yet been configured

devdoc.title: Filtered Minter contract that allows tokens to be minted with ETH or any ERC-20 token.

PricePerTokenInWeiUpdated(uint256,uint25.notice: Price per token in wei updated for project `_projectId` to `_pricePerTokenInWei`.

ProjectCurrencyInfoUpdated(uint256,addre.notice: Currency updated for project `_projectId` to symbol `_currencySymbol` and address `_currencyAddress`.

checkYourAllowanceOfProjectERC20(uint256.notice: Gets your allowance for this minter of the ERC-20 token currently set as the payment currency for project `_projectId`.

constructor.notice: Initializes contract to be a Filtered Minter for `_minterFilter`, integrated with Art Blocks core contract at address `_genArt721Address`.

genArt721CoreAddress().notice: Core contract address this minter interacts with

getPriceInfo(uint256).notice: Gets if price of token is configured, price of minting a token on project `_projectId`, and currency symbol and address to be used as payment. Supersedes any core contract price information.

getYourBalanceOfProjectERC20(uint256).notice: Gets your balance of the ERC-20 token currently set as the payment currency for project `_projectId`.

minterFilterAddress().notice: Minter filter address this minter interacts with

projectMaxHasBeenInvoked(uint256).notice: projectId => has project reached its maximum number of invocations?

projectMaxInvocations(uint256).notice: projectId => project's maximum number of invocations

purchaseTo(address,uint256).notice: Purchases a token from project `_projectId` and sets the token's owner to `_to`.

setProjectMaxInvocations(uint256).notice: Sets the maximum invocations of project `_projectId` based on the value currently defined in the core contract.

togglePurchaseToDisabled(uint256).notice: Warning: Disabling purchaseTo is not supported on this minter. This method exists purely for interface-conformance purposes.

updatePricePerTokenInWei(uint256,uint256.notice: Updates this minter's price per token of project `_projectId` to be '_pricePerTokenInWei`, in Wei. This price supersedes any legacy core contract price per token value.

updateProjectCurrencyInfo(uint256,string.notice: Updates payment currency of project `_projectId` to be `_currencySymbol` at address `_currencyAddress`.
